title: CountryGeneralizer
description: Deduce the mystery nation from the Top 100 most populous countries across 36 generalization dimensions—food, fauna, flora, exports, demographics, and geography—with Hourly, Daily, Weekly 3x, and Practice challenges.

controls.mouse: Type or select a Top-100 country from the dropdown, drag/zoom the Geo-Radar map, and switch Hourly/Daily/Weekly/Practice resets or Sets & Decks.
